items.q: Did the end of slavery in 1865 give Black Americans equal rights?
items.correct: No — segregation (Jim Crow) and discrimination continued for a century.
items.why: Legal freedom was followed by decades of segregation and disenfranchisement.

items.q: Was the Civil Rights Movement led only by Martin Luther King?
items.correct: No — many people and groups (NAACP, SNCC, Rosa Parks, Malcolm X) played key roles.
items.why: Progress came from many activists, organisations and ordinary people.

items.q: Did the Civil Rights Act 1964 end racism instantly?
items.correct: No — it outlawed discrimination, but prejudice and inequality persisted.
items.misconception: Yes, it ended all racism overnight.
items.why: Laws were a major step, but social change continued long after.
